items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I told June, "Come in on the second chorus. You've got the second chorus."

ctx.x: came back. And I had to stop and figure out, "Now, what am I going to do with it, now that I've got the music. How are we going to play this thing?" You know, I just said, "Oh well, let's let June Richmond do this thing, and then we don't have to have no worries, because she can always break up a house with it." So I wrote the tune, and I asked to find out what key she wanted it in, and so forth and so on. So I wrote it up for her, and we rehearsed it... The first number when we got into the ballroom that night,…

So about the middle of the night, the guy wanted to hear "Deep In The Heart Of Texas" and everybody started hollering "Deep in The Heart of Texas'!" So Andy pulled out the arrangement, and said, "Let's lay into it, fellows; let's see what we're going to do with it." And June... I told June, "Come in on the second chorus. You've got the second chorus." So she said, "Okay." So we lit into it, and when she got through singing it, boy, she broke up the goddamn house, and that arrangement, man, led... Well, I don't…
